        m=(sq.max(axis=2)<80)
    else:

samples=[('black',0,0),('white',7,0),('white',6,4),('white',3,4)]

            if len(tys)==0: continue
            th,tw=tys.max()-tys.min()+1, txs.max()-txs.min()+1
            # crop template
            T=tm[tys.min():tys.max()+1, txs.min():txs.max()+1]
            # extracted piece bbox
            P=pm[ys.min():ys.max()+1, xs.min():xs.max()+1]
            # resize? compare bbox dims and IoU aligned top-left, maybe pad
            H=max(P.shape[0],T.shape[0]); W=max(P.shape[1],T.shape[1])
            def pad(M):

      R=resize_bool(T,H,W)
      iou=(R&P).sum()/(R|P).sum()
      if iou>scores.get(nm,(0,))[0]: scores[nm]=(iou,fn,s)
    ranked=sorted(((v[0],k,v[1],v[2]) for k,v in scores.items()),reverse=True)
    print(f'{lab:3s}',col,' | '.join(f'{k}:{iou:.3f}@{fn.replace("DejaVu","").replace(".ttf","")}s{s}' for iou,k,fn,s in ranked[:3]))
